impact: Login was unavailable for 50 minutes. 6,700 sessions failed.
stated_cause: A certificate rotation removed the intermediate chain, so clients could not validate the leaf.
contributing_factors: Rotation is manual with no chain verification step.
Certificate expiry monitoring does not check chain completeness.
narrative: An engineer restarted the edge fleet before the alert fired.

action_items.title: Verify the full chain during rotation
